title: LARGE FOR TV GROWS THE WORLD TEXT
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, item 15 (reading the game on a TV). The HUD SIZE setting had a LARGE FOR TV choice that did nothing yet. It now draws the words over the world (nameplates, party names, damage numbers and the floating loot and kill labels) 1.3 times larger, plates and all, so they read from across the room. The HUD panels themselves are left alone while the new HUD is being designed. STANDARD is unchanged. Nothing about play changes.
now: HUD SIZE LARGE FOR TV now draws nameplates, damage numbers and loot labels 1.3 times larger.
